name: logs-agent-success
purpose: Check agent decisions when building or diagnosing Catalyst logs workflows.

cases.title: Wrong view for custom output
cases.prompt: The checkout function has HTTP 200 Access Logs, but I cannot find my console.error('payment_failed') text there. Is logging broken?
expected_behavior: Searches Application logs for the same function/time.
Checks severity filtering before declaring logging broken.
failure_behavior: Expects all code output in Access logs.
cases.pass_signal: Agent selects Application logs for the error message.

cases.title: Internal execution logs
cases.prompt: An Event function has an execution ID in its history, but Access Logs is empty. Where should I look?
expected_behavior: Uses Application logs and the execution ID.
Explains that Event invocations do not pass through the Access layer.
failure_behavior: Waits for Access logs to populate.
cases.pass_signal: Agent retrieves the relevant internal execution through Application logs.

cases.title: Retention boundary
cases.prompt: I need a Catalyst Development function's logs from ten days ago. The same time filter works for recent calls. Can changing filters recover them?
expected_behavior: Does not promise recovery or APM backfill.
Distinguishes Production's fourteen-day retention if relevant.
failure_behavior: Says all logs remain for thirty days.
Claims enabling APM recovers those log entries.
cases.pass_signal: Agent correctly explains that the requested Development logs are outside retention.

cases.title: Runtime logging methods
cases.prompt: My Node.js Catalyst function crashes with console.warning is not a function. Also show the equivalent Python warning call.
expected_behavior: Uses a Python logging logger's warning method.
cases.pass_signal: Agent provides valid Node.js and Python logging calls.

cases.title: Empty AppSail tool results
cases.prompt: CatalystbyZoho_Get_Logs returns an empty list for my AppSail service. The endpoint is responding. What should I check before concluding there is no application output?
expected_behavior: Inspects the exposed tool schema and resource/log-type/time/environment filters.
Cross-checks AppSail console logs using the service reference.
failure_behavior: Concludes there is no output from one tool response.
Applies only the function-type log matrix to the container.
cases.pass_signal: Agent verifies filters and AppSail console evidence.
